source.prompt: Create a landing page for a digital/design/marketing agency. Include hero, features, testimonials, stats, footer. Professional look. No real addresses or staff names.

notes: Quintessential AI-generated agency page: purple-to-pink gradient, blur blobs in hero, emoji service cards with identical generic titles (Expertise/Results/Client-Focused), Michael R./Jennifer T. testimonials, made-up stats, no team names, no tech stack, no real projects, no pricing.
